_about: OCCL (laneOCCLUSION). EDITOR-ONLY data (not read at runtime, so no StreamingAssets copy; add 'occlusion.json' to Tools/build_config.json build.editorOnlyData). Read by Assets/Editor/OcclusionCull.cs. enabled=false makes the step a no-op that also CLEARS flags and baked data (kill switch: rebuild).

occludee._about: Every opaque MeshRenderer under these Arena child groups gets StaticEditorFlags.OccludeeStatic. Groups are PropsLayout group names (props_layout_ground.json 'groups'). Props/Boulders (the play area dressing) are included: they are static in the layout.
occludee._maxRadius: 0 = no limit. Bounds the baked volume (bake time scales with the static bounds / smallestOccluder^3). WorldFar reaches ~330 m.

occluder._about: OccluderStatic on (a) every renderer under rootNames (the gate wall) and (b) every prop root whose id matches an assetPatterns regex AND whose LOD0 bounds longest side >= minLongestSide AND thickness (shortest horizontal side) >= minThickness. lod0Only: only the LOD0 child is an occluder (LOD1/2 stay occludee only), so a distant LOD swap does not change the occluder set.

skip._about: Never flagged, never occludee, never occluder. Dynamic things must stay dynamic.

compute._about: Unity StaticOcclusionCulling bake parameters (Unity defaults 5 / 0.25 / 100). smallestHole 0.25 keeps the 4.8 m doorway tunnel open; smallestOccluder 5 means only things >= 5 m occlude. Lower smallestOccluder = tighter culling but a much longer bake.
compute._minAssetBytes: OCCLV2: the bake is reported EMPTY (Debug.LogError + report line) when the saved OcclusionCullingData.asset is smaller than this. v109av/ay baked 268950 bytes of asset (64288 PVS bytes).

camera._about: useOcclusionCulling is set on these cameras. mainCamera=true: Camera.main. offNames: cameras forced OFF (finisher / free / capture cameras that may sit outside the baked view cells or look from inside geometry).
